design_rationale: Trust, clarity, and speed are paramount for a pharmacy POS in a medical context. The UI avoids clinical coldness by utilizing warm stone-greys and deep forest greens, establishing trust and calm.

layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism. Crisp 1px borders (border-gray-200) with subtle or no shadows.

component_guidelines.buttons: Solid backgrounds for primary actions (bg-[#166534] text-white hover:bg-[#14532D]). Flat with 1px border for secondary. No heavy shadows.
component_guidelines.cards: White background, rounded-md, 1px border (border-gray-200), tight padding (p-4 or p-6).
component_guidelines.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned data, clear zebra striping or bottom borders. FEFO badges inline.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn default with focus:ring-[#166534]. Must have visible contrast.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sidebar navigation with Lucide icons. Fixed position, high contrast active states.

login_background.description: Abstract green background for the login page hero section.
login_background.usage: Use with a heavy overlay (e.g. bg-white/80 or bg-gray-50/90) behind the login card to provide medical-themed texture without overwhelming the form.

accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Warning and danger text should be paired with light background colors for badges (e.g., bg-red-50 text-red-600).
accessibility_and_motion.motion: Minimalistic micro-interactions. Subtle transforms on button hover (-translate-y-[1px]).
accessibility_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., 'pos-add-to-cart-button', 'login-submit').

key_features_design_requirements.dashboard: Use bento grid for KPIs: CA du jour, Ordonnances, Valeur Stock. Must include a 'Alertes Péremption' widget with red/orange badges.
key_features_design_requirements.pos_module: Split screen: 2/3 dense product search and list, 1/3 fixed right sidebar for current cart/basket. Auto-select FEFO lot.
key_features_design_requirements.fefo_badges: Always display FEFO status clearly. Green = Safe (> 6 months), Orange = Expiring Soon (< 6 months), Red = Expired.
key_features_design_requirements.i18n: Design must accommodate text expansion for FR/EN language switching.
